simple.meaning: to close up; especially to seal
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָתַם (H2856) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 27 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חָתַם (châtham) means to close up; especially to seal First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 21 8.

definitions.short: to close up; especially to seal
definitions.usage: make an end, mark, seal (up), stop.
definitions.full: H2856. chatham חָתַם verb seal, affix seal, seal up (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic חֲתַם , ; Ethiopic Arabic (whence ) is loan-word according to Frä 252 ) — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular יַחְתֹּם Job 9:7 ; 33:6 , יַחְתּוֺם 37:7 , וַיַּחְתֹּם Est 8:10 , etc.; Imperative חֲתֹם Dan 12:4 , חֲתוֺם Isa 8:16 , חִתְמוּ Est 8:8 ; Infinitive absolute חָתוֺם Jer 32:44 ; construct לַחְתֹּם Dan 9:24 , + 9:24 Kt (Qr לְהָתֵם ); Participle active חוֺתֵם Ezek 28:12 ; pass . חָתוּם Deut 32:24 2 t., etc.; — 1 seal, affix one's seal , in attestation; seal with king's seal ( בְּחֹתָמוֺ ) 1Kin 21:8 , המלך בְּטַבַּעַת Est 8:8 , 10 ; of covenant with ׳י , attested by seal (passive) Neh 10:1 ; 10:2 ; figurative, of ׳י putting his seal upon ( בְּ ) discipline, i.e. ratifying it, Job 33:16 ; perhaps also upon hand of man (that man may know ׳י s ways) 37:7 see De; Di below 2 seal up hand of man, so that he cannot work with it (in winter). 2 seal up, fasten up by sealing , a deed of sale Jer 32:10-11 ,(opposed to הַגָּלוּי that which was left open ,), 32:14 ; 32:44 , a book of prophecy Dan 12:4 (|| הַדְּבָרים סְתֹם ), compare 12:9 (|| id. ), 9:24 b; so in simileof unintelligible prophecy Isa 29:11 (twice in verse); בְּלְמֻּדָ֑י תּוֺרָה חֲתֹם 8:16 seal up the teaching among my disciples , i.e. keep it securely (|| צוֺר ); of ׳י s remembrance of offences בְּאוֺצְרֹתָ֑י חָתוּם Deut 32:34 (|| עְמָּדִי כָּמֻס ), so מִּשְׁעִי בִּצְרוֺר חָתוּם Job 14:17 (|| עַלעֲֿוֺנִי וַתִּטְמֹּל ); חָתוּם מַעְיָן Song 4:12 a fountain sealed up , metaphor of chaste woman (|| נָעוּל (גַּל) גַּן ); יַח כּוֺכָבִים ׳וּבְעַד Job 9:7 and about the stars he putteth a seal (|| of forbidding sun to rise). — תָּכְנִית חוֺתֵם אַתָּה Ezek 28:12 is obscure: thou wast one sealing proportion , i.e. perfection , — wast complete perfection, Ges Sm.; wast a sealer of symmetry see Da; wast a seal (ring) — i.e. חוֺתַם construct — of proportion Manuscripts ᵑ9 ᵐ5 Hi compare Ew; text perhaps corrupt, see suggestions in Co. — Dan 9:24 a read Qr לְהָתֵם (see תמם ). Job 33:16 ; 37:7 see below 1.
